checked_by: Member 2 (each clause read against the downloaded PDF, SHA-256 70ec4e51...a75b)
note: Maps the settlement engine's rule_ref values (servers/settlement_engine/engine/rules.py RULE_REFS) to clause IDs in this wording. The first clause listed is the one to cite; the rest are supporting definitions or lists.

room_rent_cap.where: C.1 item i: room rent up to 2% of sum insured, maximum Rs. 5,000 per day

icu_cap.where: C.1 item ii: ICU/ICCU up to 5% of sum insured, maximum Rs. 10,000 per day

gst_follows_charge.where: Not addressed in this wording; the engine's rule follows general practice. Member 1 to confirm.

proportionate_deduction.where: C.1.1 Notes 2 and 3: proportionate deduction except pharmacy and consumables, implants and medical devices, diagnostics; not applied where the hospital does not follow differential billing
proportionate_deduction.differs_from_engine: Note 2 applies the proportionate deduction when the room OR ICU/ICCU rate exceeds its limit. The engine (IRDAI 2020 norm) never triggers it from an ICU excess. Decided: the engine keeps the IRDAI 2020 rule (eval/dev_cases/decisions.json).

non_payable_items.where: C.7 points to Annexure A: List I optional (non-payable) items, Lists II-IV items subsumed into room, procedure or treatment charges, List V additional non-payable items

cataract_limit.where: C.3: 25% of sum insured or Rs. 40,000, whichever is lower, per eye per policy year

initial_waiting_period.where: D.2 (Code Excl03): first 30 days, except accidents

listed_illness_waiting_period.where: D.3 (Code Excl02): 24 months for the listed conditions, 36 months for joint replacement and age-related osteoarthritis/osteoporosis; continuity of cover counts

pre_existing_waiting_period.where: D.1 (Code Excl01): 36 months of continuous coverage from first inception

copay.where: E.28.3: each claim subject to a co-payment of 5% of the admissible claim amount; amount payable is after the co-payment

sum_insured.where: A (operative clause): maximum liability per policy year is the sum insured plus cumulative bonus

expenses_actually_incurred.where: B.26 defines Medical Expenses as those necessarily and actually incurred, so a charge billed twice for the same day is paid once

pre_hospitalisation.where: C.4: pre-hospitalisation expenses for a fixed period of 30 days before the admission

post_hospitalisation.where: C.5: post-hospitalisation expenses for a fixed period of 60 days from the discharge

ambulance_limit.where: C.1.1 item v: road ambulance up to Rs. 2,000 per hospitalisation (Annexure A List I item 67 points to this sub-limit)

policy_period.where: A (operative clause): the company pays when an insured person is hospitalised during the policy period
